prompt: How do I authenticate requests to the Example API? Answer from the example-docs documentation in three short sentences, and cite the page URL.
answer:
Create an API key in the dashboard under Settings > API Keys. Send it in the `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` header, or pass `apiKey` to the SDK `Client`. To act on behalf of users, use OAuth 2.0 instead.

Source: https://example.com/docs/api/authentication
